description: Type the 429 a create, resume or fork gets when the account has used every sandbox start its plan includes in the last hour: {"code": "rate_limited", "message": "You used all 60 sandbox starts included in the last hour.\nYour running sandboxes keep running. New ones can start again at 17:23 UTC.…"}. Observed live 2026-11-07 on POST /sandboxes. The error carries no httpError trait on purpose: as a 429 it would be classed as throttling and retried indefinitely, but the window is an hour, so it fails at once.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The account used every sandbox start its plan includes in the last hour (resumes and forks count). The message says when starts are available again; extra starts can be enabled in Boat's billing settings.
